glosses: to glean (to find out or discover by reading)
to figure (to make a guess based on signs or indications)
to read off, to read out (to read aloud one or more items from a list)
to read over, to read through (to read all of)
to glean (to decipher damaged or otherwise hard to read text)
to read up (to damage or use up by reading)
to read (to obtain information from a machine)
to read out (to happen upon by reading)
to read off, to read out (to read one's name and/or surname etc. from a list)
to read out (to appear on a computer screen)
